subject: Enablement runway, docs freeze window, and exception triage
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Atlas Systems <eng@atlas-systems.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Enablement runway, docs freeze window, and exception triage

Hi all,

I want to lock in the high-level plan for the December activation we discussed in the roadmap sync. Key asks:

- Confirm a docs freeze window for public-facing docs and SDK samples (proposed: Dec 7-13).
- Publish enablement slots for CS/APIs and engineering Q&A between Dec 14-16.
- Define an exception triage flow for customer-specific blockers (latency/regulatory/feature gaps).

Atlas (cc'd) has a soft go-live target the week of Dec 20; they need the SDK samples and a short runbook beforehand.

Attachments: enablement_slots.xlsx (draft availability), docs_freeze_timeline.gsheet (drive link), exception_triage_matrix.pdf (initial template).

Can each of you confirm owners and any hard constraints by end of this week? I'll consolidate and produce a short checklist for release ops.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Product Program Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: enablement_slots.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: docs_freeze_timeline.gsheet (application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Atlas Systems <eng@atlas-systems.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Enablement runway, docs freeze window, and exception triage

Naomi — thanks for the clear ask. A few product/save-the-date notes from my side:

1) Docs freeze: Dec 7-13 generally works, but we need a carve-out for the runtime performance notes. Engineering may need to push a small patch on Dec 9 that affects the "performance tuning" section; request: allow a single PR exemption if code rollout is gated and small.

2) SDK samples: are we shipping JS + Python parity? Atlas asked specifically for a Go snippet for their infra team. If we can't do Go before Dec 14, suggest a small "how-to" that explains calling the REST API; engineering can add Go later.

3) Exception triage: suggest we add an SLA for triage acknowledgment (4 business hours) and a clear owner per exception type (security -> Vivek, latency -> Karthik, docs -> Marissa).

I'll block time on Dec 8 to review the performance note PRs with the runtime team.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Atlas Systems <eng@atlas-systems.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Enablement runway, docs freeze window, and exception triage

Thanks Naomi — I've reviewed the draft slots and updated the sheet (see attached). High-level:

- Enablement office hours (60 min) on Dec 14 + 15 (two sessions each day: Americas/EU).
- Deep-dive engineering Q&A (90 min) on Dec 16 (recorded).
- Two customer rehearsal slots for Atlas: Dec 17 morning (pre-prod) and Dec 18 morning (cutover dry-run).

Doc ownership:
- Marissa (public quickstarts + SDK samples)
- Evelyn (runbook + operational playbook)
- Karthik (release notes + performance notes)

Marissa
Director, Developer Experience
[Attachment: enablement_slots.xlsx (updated)]

From: Sarah Conway <sarah.conway@bigretail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Enablement runway, docs freeze window, and exception triage

Hi team,

Atlas (BigRetail platform) here — thanks for the timeline. A few constraints from our side:

- We can't do the pre-prod rehearsal on Dec 17; can we move to Dec 16 afternoon? Our infra team has a hard freeze on Dec 17-19 for year-end reporting.
- We need the Go snippet by Dec 14 at the latest. If that's not possible, we will take the REST example but prefer a short Go example we can drop into our deployment scripts.
- On the exception triage SLA — 4 business hours for acknowledgment is acceptable, but we need an escalation path to an on-call engineer if a triage leads to a production blocker.

Thanks — Sarah Conway
Platform Integrations, Atlas Systems

On Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 08:30 Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Naomi — I've reviewed the draft slots and updated the sheet (see attached).
>

> 
> Marissa

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Atlas Systems <eng@atlas-systems.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Enablement runway, docs freeze window, and exception triage

Quick update — I attached an updated exception_triage_matrix.pdf with suggested owners and the escalation ladder. Highlights:

- Triage ack SLA: 4 business hours (as proposed).
- Full incident evaluation: 24 hours for classification; 72 hours for mitigation plan (for non-security issues).
- Escalation: on-call -> product lead -> Eng triage -> Security (if flagged).

I also added two new exception types we saw in past launches:
- Model output regression (QA/ops lead: Marissa)
- Region-specific latency (owner: Karthik; ops escalation to Vivek)

Evelyn
Principal Technical Writer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: exception_triage_matrix.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Sarah Conway <sarah.conway@bigretail.com>, Atlas Systems <eng@atlas-systems.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Enablement runway, docs freeze window, and exception triage

Thanks everyone — summary and commitments below (please treat as the single source of truth for readiness):

Dec 7-13: Docs freeze (exceptions: one PR exemption for performance notes on Dec 9). Owner: Marissa (final reviewer).
Dec 14: SDK samples published (JS/Python; Go snippet by EOD Dec 14 if engineering can deliver; otherwise provide REST + short Go how-to). Owner: Marissa + Engineering.
Dec 14-15: Enablement office hours (Americas/EU).
Dec 16: Deep-dive engineering Q&A (recorded).
Dec 16 (afternoon): Atlas rehearsal moved per request — booked (Marissa).
Dec 17-18: Customer dry-run window; Atlas will use Dec 17 only if their freeze changes.
Exception triage: Acknowledgment SLA: 4 business hours. Escalation ladder as attached. Owners: Security -> Vivek; Latency -> Karthik; Docs/runbook -> Evelyn/Marissa.

Action items:
- Marissa: finalize enablement_slots.xlsx and publish calendar invites (by EOD Mon, Nov 30).
- Karthik: confirm final wording for the performance PR exemption and sign off (by Tue, Dec 1).
- Evelyn: finalize exception_triage_matrix.pdf with on-call contacts (by Tue, Dec 1).
- Vivek: confirm on-call escalation path and who will be paged for region latency (by Tue, Dec 1).
- Atlas (Sarah): confirm if Go snippet is required otherwise accept REST+how-to (by Tue, Dec 1).

I'll produce a short release ops checklist after Tuesday consolidating all sign-offs. If there are unresolved items, flag them in-thread.

Best,
Naomi
Senior Product Program Manager, Redwood Inference
